subject: Invoice routing for split ledgers — portal enrollment + PO exceptions
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@lumina-ai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumina AI AP <ap@lumina-ai.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice delivery for multi-entity group — origin & PO exceptions

Hi Vanessa,

We’re onboarding Redwood for three legal entities post-close and need to lock the invoice origin and delivery path. A few specifics from our AP side:

- We need invoices to clearly state which legal entity is issuing and include the corresponding Lumina bill-to code.
- Two entities (Lumina, Lumina Europe) prefer portal delivery. One legacy entity (Lumina Legacy LLC) still requires emailed PDFs and PO-based routing.
- We have PO-based router rules: if an invoice contains PO prefix LUM-LEGACY it must go to legacy-payables@lumina-ai.com and be treated as a PO exception (no portal pull).
- VAT evidence: we can provide certificates but need a list of what you require for EU reverse-charges.
- Can you share a sample invoice payload and confirm invoice number schema so our AP systems can map automatically?

Can you propose a path (portal enrollment timeline + email exceptions + SFTP fallback) and confirm who at Redwood will be the canonical sender for each legal entity? We’re on a tight payroll window so hoping to finalize in 48 hours.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Khan
AP Manager, Lumina AI
[sent from Lumina AP]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@lumina-ai.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for multi-entity group — origin & PO exceptions

Sara — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Connor (AP onboarding) and Marissa (billing ops) so we can propose a practical playbook. High level recommendation: hybrid with portal as canonical for two entities and email copies for the legacy entity, with PO exception rules honored at emission time.

Key points from Redwood side:
- Canonical invoice sender: Redwood Inference (invoices@redwood.ai), with a per-entity invoice prefix in the invoice number (e.g., RW-LUM-000123, RW-LUM-EU-000123, RW-LUM-LEG-000123). That should make automated routing by PO prefix straightforward.
- Portal enrollment: we can enroll up to three entities in parallel. Typical timeline: portal provisioning (1 business day), SSO + AP user invites (2–3 business days), verification and test invoice (1 business day) — total 4–5 business days if Lumina supplies entity/legal names + remit addresses + primary AP contact per entity.
- Email copies / PO exceptions: for Lumina Legacy LLC we’ll emit the invoice via portal (canonical) and also push an emailed PDF to legacy-payables@lumina-ai.com if the invoice contains the LUM-LEGACY prefix. We’ll mark that invoice with the RW-LUM-LEG number and set the envelope header X-PO-Exception: true.
- SFTP fallback: we support scheduled nightly SFTP drops; we can enable once you provide host + creds (we’ll rotate keys).
- VAT evidence: please attach VAT certs per entity; for EU reverse-charge we need VAT number + certificate or tax residence doc. I’ve attached a short checklist and a sample invoice payload.

Attached: sample_invoice_template.xml (sample payload), invoice_onboarding_checklist.pdf (VAT checklist)

If acceptable I’ll have Connor kick off provisioning and draft the portal invites and mapping table.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Billing Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_invoice_template.xml]
[Attachment: invoice_onboarding_checklist.pdf]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@lumina-ai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for multi-entity group — origin & PO exceptions

Sara — quick operational follow-up and what we’ll need to start provisioning:

1) Legal entity mapping table (please reply with a one-row CSV):
   - Legal entity name, Bill-to code, VAT number (if EU), Preferred delivery (portal/email), Primary AP contact (name + email).
2) Confirm PO routing rules: is the LUM-LEGACY prefix applied by your PO system, and should we treat any invoice containing that substring as a guaranteed email copy (no portal-only)?
3) Invoice number schema confirmed: we will use the RW-<ENTITY>-NNNNNN format. If you want a different prefix we can map.
4) Test invoice: once we have the mapping table we will send a test invoice and a downloadable XML payload to your test mailbox (ap+test@lumina-ai.com). Please confirm test mailbox.

Operational notes:
- We’ll set per-entity remittance instructions in the invoice PDF and include a machine-readable XML for your AP system.
- For VAT reverse-charge: if you send a signed VAT certificate for Lumina Europe we’ll include the reverse-charge tax code on the invoice line and suppress VAT.
- Exceptions & escalations: Marissa will own short-term reissues (within 5 business days), Vanessa will own overall design decisions.

Next steps: please paste the CSV into a reply and attach the VAT certs. I’ll open the onboarding ticket and share the Drive folder where we’ll collect documents.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
AP Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@lumina-ai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@lumina-ai.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for multi-entity group — origin & PO exceptions

Thanks everyone — confirming the CSV below and attaching the VAT cert for Lumina Europe. We’ll start portal invites for Lumina and Lumina Europe; Lumina Legacy LLC wants the email-copy-only path for now. Test mailbox: ap+test@lumina-ai.com.

CSV (paste):
Lumina Inc,LUM-NA,US-000123,portal,ap@lumina-ai.com
Lumina Europe,LUM-EU,EU-987654,portal,eu-ap@lumina-ai.com
Lumina Legacy LLC,LUM-LEG,US-LEG-5555,email-only,legacy-payables@lumina-ai.com

PO routing: yes — our PO system appends the LUM-LEGACY substring when the order belongs to the legacy entity. Please treat that as the trigger for the email copy and PO exception.

Attached: lumina_vat_certificate.pdf

We’re good to go on your timeline — please kick off provisioning and send the test invoice to ap+test@lumina-ai.com.

Best,
Sara Khan
